headline: Splash screens, animated. Your app, ready for agents.
summary: An animated HTML splash screen for universal apps, experimental WebMCP support, and the same calm terminal output across every CLI command.
notes: Add `public/splashscreen.html`. One file, no network, and the native splash hands over to it.
Ask an agent in plain words. It calls the tools your app registered.

headline: On-device AI on iOS. Edge-to-edge, done right.
summary: useAI runs on-device on iOS through LiteRT-LM or Apple Foundation Models, and Android edge-to-edge draws under transparent bars with insets in CSS pixels.

headline: Catalyst 1.0. Build on it.
summary: The first stable release. The public API is frozen, React Router becomes a peer dependency, and the root entry exports exactly eight names.
